Subject: Budget for the diagnostic
Date: Thursday 29 October 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Delphine Roux <delphine.roux@pellowventures.example.test>

Delphine,

Noting where we are. You said you would let me know the budget for the diagnostic by the 20th of next month, once the investment committee has met.

I will hold two weeks in December provisionally.

Best,
Dom
